content.warrantySummary: Boise Cabinet Co stands behind your cabinets with a limited lifetime warranty: we warrant to the original homeowner that cabinet boxes, doors, and hardware are free from defects in materials and workmanship for the lifetime of original home ownership, under normal use. Conditions apply (e.g., door warping is covered only within the first 180 days); damage from moisture, heat, chemicals, improper installation, or normal wear is excluded.
content.warrantyNote: Internal: present this as Boise Cabinet Co's own warranty. Boise must be able to honor and administer these terms; all warranty claims route to Boise Cabinet Co. Legal review recommended before launch.
